name: devctl-app-ui
description: Mode-agnostic frontend for aw-app-devctl (ADR "Apps Own Their Front + Back Routes" Decision 3/4/5). src/client.js is the framework-free tab-relay core; src/plugin.js is the integrated-mode entry (register(host), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle); src/standalone.js + index.html is the standalone page. `npm run build` produces ui/dist/, consumed by BOTH __main__.py (standalone) and aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle (integrated).

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:standalone
